page_title: VAL 0-0 MAL | Valencia v Mallorca 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
90' Samu Costa (Mallorca) was probably a bit loose with his words to Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias, who decides to show him a yellow.
86' Selim Amallah (Valencia) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.

84' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Giorgi Mamardashvili allowed him to make a comfortable save.
81' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Hugo Duro (Valencia), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Perez leaves the pitch and Selim Amallah (Valencia) comes on.
80' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alberto Mari (Valencia) replacing Hugo Guillamon.
79' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and it's Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
78' Here's the change. Manu Morlanes leaves the pitch and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
77' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
75' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
74' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
74' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
73' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
72' Hugo Duro (Valencia) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
71' Here is a change. Nacho Vidal is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca).
71' Substitution. Jaume Costa makes his way off the pitch and Toni Lato (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
70' What a save from Dominik Greif! Hugo Duro (Valencia) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
66' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
66' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Mallorca.
65' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) replaces Dimitri Foulquier.
65' Substitution. Peter Gonzalez is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
62' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
62' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hugo Duro (Valencia).
58' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header high over the bar! A typical school boy’s error!
52' Fran Perez (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
48' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
48' Pepelu (Valencia) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Dominik Greif to dive and make a save.

47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Valencia win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
46' Hugo Duro (Valencia) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
46' Javier Aguirre has made a change at the break. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) has come on in place of Cyle Larin.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The foul by Thierry Correia (Valencia) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Excellent touch by Diego Lopez (Valencia)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
42' Mallorca quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' The free kick is taken by Sergi Darder (Mallorca), but ball is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
41' Thierry Correia (Valencia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
40' A cross into the box from Thierry Correia (Valencia) is cleared.
38' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
35' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Omar Mascarell limps off the pitch to be replaced by Samu Costa (Mallorca).
33' Looks like Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
31' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
31' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) attempts to discuss the decision with Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
30' Pepelu (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
30' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) probably handled the ball. PENALTY! One of the players from Valencia is about to take a penalty kick.
28' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Giorgi Mamardashvili.
27' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
24' The ball goes behind for a corner. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Wow, what an escape. Hugo Duro (Valencia) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
23' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
22' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) picks up an injury.
22' Fran Perez (Valencia) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
18' Flag up against Jaume Costa (Mallorca). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Lopez (Valencia) is coming onto the pitch as Roman Yaremchuk cannot continue after picking up an injury.
16' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
14' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' The cross into the penalty area from Jaume Costa (Mallorca) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
8' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
7' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
5' The game is interrupted. Jaume Costa (Mallorca) suffers a horrific injury!
1' The first half has just begun.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will supervise the game today.
